name: @avatark/auth-ui
description: Canonical, reusable AvatarK sign-in UI -- headless and prop-driven, no data fetching, no Supabase credentials, no assumed project ref. Consumes @avatark/auth for return-path safety and callback error classification; hosts supply capability detection, submit handlers, and product identity config.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
